source.note: The branch head was reconciled against current main; D revision/event-id contracts were preserved and E tests were corrected before integration.

behavior.preferencesEndpoints: GET, PUT, and PATCH /workspaces/:organizationId/notifications/preferences manage per-user muted categories with tenant and role guards.
behavior.categoryMutingInFeed: GET /workspaces/:organizationId/notifications excludes muted categories by default; includeMuted=true or an explicit category query exposes them.
behavior.categoryMutingInSummary: GET /workspaces/:organizationId/notifications/summary excludes muted categories from unread totals by default and includes them with includeMuted=true.
behavior.auditTrail: Each update appends AuditLog action notifications.preferences.updated; no schema or migration change is introduced.
behavior.isolation: HTTP tests cover CLIENT denial, cross-tenant 404, PATCH, muted list/summary and explicit category override.

fullUnit.reason: Windows worktree lacks configured render fonts/librsvg prerequisites; notification-focused cases pass.

local.integrationHarnessReason: Owned verifier cannot safely start its isolated Redis because 127.0.0.1:6379 is occupied; no existing service was stopped or contacted.
local.directIntegrationInvocation: Refused by tests/support/isolated.ts; integration tests must run through scripts/verify-local.mjs.

limits: In-app preferences only; no external push/email delivery, realtime stream or SLO claim.
Local HTTP/integration execution was not forced against the occupied Redis service; exact CI must provide the isolated native services.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production live/deployed/provider, remote durability/RPO-RTO and full-master acceptance remain open.
